scenes.text: Have you ever walked through a quiet forest and felt like you were being watched, only to realize you actually were?
Under your feet lies a massive, hidden network made of fungi, connecting every single tree in a Wood Wide Web.
Through this underground network, trees can send nutrients to their offspring and warn neighboring trees about incoming pest attacks.
Now that you know trees are actively talking to each other, do you think they have feelings—let me know in the comments and hit follow!
